citations.claim: first violation: penetration of wall 0 exceeds 0.15 limit
penetration distance at violation step is 0.2004 over limit
one step before violation penetration already negative but within tolerance (-0.0508)
two steps before violation body still outside wall (+0.098 clearance)

counterfactual.change: Changed dt from 0.017126384970189156 to 0.005 (single field). Finer substeps restore correct collision detection/correction for wall corner penetration, violation disappears with same geometry, velocities and 24 steps.

explanation: Body 0 falls and moves left toward thin vertical wall (x=14,W=0.3,y=2.8,h=5.5). With dt~0.0171 and 5-6 substeps per step the discrete integration steps penetrate the wall corner. Inspect shows distance_to_surface goes 0.245 (step21) ->0.098 (step22) -> -0.051 (step23, within limit) -> -0.2004 (step24, violation), with no bounce/correction applied despite overlapping. Positional correction / impulse for the vertical side/top-corner is not sufficient at this dt, so penetration grows linearly each step. Reducing dt to 0.005 (same steps, geometry, velocities) gives finer substeps and eliminates the penetration, proving numerical resolution / collision handling at this dt-corner interaction is the cause.
vision_note: The red circular body falls vertically onto the top end of the thin dark vertical wall. By step 24 its lower edge visibly intersects/overlaps the top of the wall instead of colliding and rebounding or coming to rest on it.
